description: Source code for LazyTensor implementation and device guard management in PyTorch's lazy core module, including class definitions, device handling, and tensor size management.

classes.name: LTCGuardImpl
classes.description: Implementation of device guard interface for Lazy device type, managing device and stream operations.

classes.name: LTCTensorImpl
classes.description: Tensor implementation class for LazyTensor, managing tensor size, shape, and device properties.

methods.name: set_tensor
methods.description: Sets the internal LazyTensor pointer and resets generation.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the tensor implementation, optionally detaching.

methods.name: shallow_copy_from
methods.description: Copies tensor metadata and data from another tensor implementation.

methods.name: setup_size_properties
methods.description: Updates size and stride properties based on the current tensor shape.

methods.name: sizes_custom
methods.description: Returns the sizes of the tensor, setting up size properties if needed.

methods.name: strides_custom
methods.description: Returns the strides of the tensor, setting up size properties if needed.

methods.name: dim_custom
methods.description: Returns the tensor's dimension, setting up size properties if needed.

methods.name: numel_custom
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the tensor, setting up size properties if needed.

methods.name: storage_offset_custom
methods.description: Returns the storage offset, always 0 for lazy tensors.

methods.name: is_strides_like_custom
methods.description: Checks if tensor strides are like a specified memory format.

methods.name: sym_is_non_overlapping_and_dense_custom
methods.description: Returns whether the tensor is non-overlapping and dense (currently fixed to false).

methods.name: sym_is_contiguous_custom
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is contiguous.
